caption: The Founder
title: Afshan Umar
description: Afshan Umar, the founder of Flavour Fusion, brings a refined eye for flavour and presentation to every menu she creates. With a deep passion for thoughtfully crafted food and memorable experiences, she believes great catering is about balance, intention, and care — not excess. Her hands-on approach ensures that every dish reflects quality ingredients, modern sensibilities, and a personal touch, making each gathering feel effortless, elevated, and truly special.
